NEXVORA HRVIEW

HRView

For companies with field teams, shifts and more than one site

Attendance, leave and payroll in one place. Staff clock in on their phone with a selfie at the job site, overtime comes straight from their clock-in and clock-out times, and payroll works out EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB for you.

  • Selfie and GPS clock-in, checked against each job site
  • Overtime from clock times, approved by HR before payroll
  • Leave requests and Employment Act balances
  • Payroll with EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB worked out
  • Payslips, EA forms and monthly files for KWSP, PERKESO and LHDN
